newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 wheat crop seen at 65 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 wheat crop seen at 65 mln tonnes.

text.p: India's wheat output in 1996/97 (July-June) is expected to be around 65 million tonnes compared with 62.6 million last year, a senior official at the Agriculture Ministry told Reuters on Monday.
"The wheat crop in 1996/97 will be around 65 million tonnes," the official, who asked not to be identified, said.

He said rust disease in the northern state of Punjab and high temperature during harvesting time in March 1996 had contributed to low output in 1995/96. India produced 65.47 million tonnes of wheat in 1994/95.
Punjab contributes around 20 percent to the country's wheat production.
"Area reduction was also there which is likely to improve this year," the official said.

The Press Trust of India quoted officials of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, a government research body, as saying on Monday that the 1996/97 crop was expected at around 68 million tonnes.
